summary: Final pre-acceptance review checked implementation against the whole-round evidence contract, repaired two release/argument gaps, and inspected the actual separate Java host call before running full regression and new demonstration artifacts.
findings: A candidate deferred by the breadth cap previously lacked an early bundle association. It now binds its bundle before deferral; regression asserts that old release controls remain blocked.

Argument premise cycles, duplicate assumption/argument identifiers, undeclared objections and excessive dependency depth are now rejected. Retained source spans receive schema validation before offset resolution.
Issue adjudication must bind the selected candidate; a decision about one alternative cannot silently authorize another. Meaning acceptance requires the full submitted inventory to be referenced.

The complete real 23EC46 candidate remains DRAFT with its original five open legal issues and two missing external sources. Its oracle, original evidence and both 232-page PDFs are protected from mutation.

The repair demonstration executes a supplied scripted edit of the omitted product-type route, then checks all 22 retained scenarios and 729 finite assignments in Python/generated Java and stores a solver witness. Scripted repair is not autonomous English interpretation.

A separate synthetic positive scenario invokes the exported generated class from a separately compiled Java caller, then proves source-change blocking and exact archive restoration. Bank systems are not contacted.

Full old/new regression, deterministic API regeneration, actual Chromium interactions and offline wheel installation are fixed supervisor commands. Human usability and independent legal effectiveness remain pending.
P2's comparison wrapper received its executable Java witness test in P3; final acceptance includes it again. Evidence dates and denominators are kept separate from the frozen T00-T22 record.
